item.title: 【Music Videos】LeAnn Rimes - Suddenly (Original Lost Official Music Video) [1080p HD MP4]
item.description:
Took me awhile to find this but this is the original "lost" music video for "Suddenly" by LeAnn Rimes. Unlike the one on Rimes' official YouTube channel (this is why I consider it lost as it wasn't official released on Rimes' YouTube channel), this one doesn't include the various scenes from View from the Top in it and just shows LeAnn Rimes. It is the one I remember seeing back in 2003 and was used on the karaoke VCD included with the Thailand release of The Best of LeAnn Rimes. I don't know if anyone else was looking for it but here it is. Hope you enjoy!
